verdict.rationale: Whether a government filing portal allows an account-free or file-number entry path is a fair question for this kind of service, so the axis applies. The only evidence is the probe, which reports that every ANEF transaction sits behind a JavaScript shell and an account. No published page documents a keyless or file-number entry path.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
